context: Request: semiconductor IP disputes of the firm where it actually litigated an injunction (conflicts and precedent check for a new chip-patent case). Rubric: one criterion, that no matter qualifies (the closest patent matter, 1014-00004, has only a contingency preliminary-injunction draft on hold and permanent-injunction planning).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Filtered file listings of three leading matters for pleading, injunction, order and closing words. The end note says the calls looked like document-type path search; no later stage did that work.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. One parallel batch of 11 reads: complaints, status and closing memos, settlement papers, a preliminary-injunction motion marked a contingency draft on hold, a permanent-injunction analysis and trial memo, and an opposition to a preliminary injunction and draft consent decree from three matters. The start note pointed to screening. The review flags that only already-picked matters were read.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: new: Widen search for other semiconductor IP injunction matters. Reads a trade-secret memo, injunction briefs, a TRO motion, a dismissal stipulation, a settlement and a closing email of one matter, plus memos of two other patent matters, and lists one folder.
stages.agent_new: Widen search for other semiconductor IP injunction matters

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that no matter meets all three parts, with the two device patent matters as near misses and two injunction matters as outside scope. The review flags a possibly narrow reading.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, a dismissal stipulation and the draft injunction motion; a path check fails on the file location, then all 16 cited paths exist.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All pass with the same procedure: store-wide path searches and extraction scans (many timed out), reads of the leading patent matter's injunction papers (an on-hold contingency draft and a proposed order) and of a handful of other injunction matters, then a strict answer that no matter qualifies, with the patent matters as near misses. T2 first wrote the leading matter as a strong match; the write-stage review said its papers were a draft and a proposed order, and the check stages rewrote the answer to the strict no-match conclusion. Agent-defined stages were all rescans, reads or path searches that existing stages describe.
